'''Sayaka Kinoshita''' (Japanese: '''木下紗華''' ''Kinoshita Sayaka'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.  

==Biography==
Kinoshita was born on July 21, 1981 in {{wp|Chiba Prefecture|Chiba}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where her only role was {{an|Lusamine}}. Kinoshita is a freelance voice actress.
